title: 6.7" Santoku chef knife
text: 6.7" Santoku chef knife. I purchased this to replace an old cheapy Santoku that amazingly did fairly well for many years - but the pink plastic handle finally gave out.  This one is clearly a better quality.  So far, it has sharpened and kept an edge fairly well.  I sharpen about every 2 washes.  The tang goes through the handle and it is balanced for my hand.  I like it.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
